guidance: three.ws and Microsoft have announced a partnership, and three.ws is live on Microsoft Marketplace with a publisher profile. Say exactly that and nothing grander: no named Microsoft partner tier, designation, co-sell status, certification or endorsement, because none has been confirmed. Microsoft Marketplace is where Azure Marketplace and Microsoft AppSource now live together; the listing is a new way for enterprise teams to find three.ws, and nothing about the product forks for that channel. Microsoft open source (TRELLIS.2 from Microsoft Research, ONNX Runtime Web, Adaptive Cards) already runs in the stack: present those as dependencies three.ws uses under their own licenses, never as something Microsoft built for or runs for three.ws. Production runs on Google Cloud and Solana is the home chain, so never say three.ws runs on or is hosted on Azure, and never imply Microsoft endorses $THREE or any trading surface.

features.title: three.ws is live on Microsoft Marketplace
features.summary: three.ws and Microsoft have announced a partnership, and three.ws now has a publisher profile on Microsoft Marketplace, the single storefront where Azure Marketplace and Microsoft AppSource now live together. An enterprise team can find three.ws inside a procurement flow it already trusts. Nothing about the product forks for the channel: the platform that runs at three.ws, 3D creation, an agent runtime with a body, the agent-3d web component, MCP tools and the Solana agent economy, is what a Microsoft customer gets. Solana remains the home chain; the listing is a new way in, not a new center of gravity.

features.title: Microsoft open source already running in three.ws
features.summary: Microsoft open source was in the three.ws stack before the partnership. TRELLIS.2 from Microsoft Research is the default image-to-3D lane, trellis2, on the self-hosted GPU fleet. ONNX Runtime Web runs speech-to-text and wake-word detection in the visitor's browser, so audio never leaves the machine. Adaptive Cards render the Glance agent cards for home screens and chat, TypeScript types every published SDK and Playwright drives the browser tests. The docs page names the file behind each one, and all of them are dependencies used under their own licenses.

features.title: What the Microsoft partnership brings builders
features.summary: The partner benefits page spells out what the Microsoft partnership brings someone building on three.ws. Enterprise teams can find three.ws, its offers and a contact path inside the Microsoft Marketplace storefront they already buy from. TRELLIS.2 from Microsoft Research is the default image-to-3D lane behind the forge, so a single photo becomes a textured 3D asset. On-device speech-to-text and wake-word detection run through ONNX Runtime Web in the browser, so a visitor's audio never leaves their machine.
